currency: All prices are in Australian dollars. The price shown is the amount you pay.
rest: Everything else is quoted on hours and given to you as a fixed total before work starts.

hosting.title: Hosting and maintenance
hosting.what: One monthly charge when we host and manage what we built for you. If you host and manage it yourself, this cost does not apply.
hosting.name: Managed hosting and maintenance

facts.label: What it covers
facts.text: Hosting, and the general maintenance needed to keep it running.

facts.label: When it applies
facts.text: One charge covers both your website and your tool. It is required for anything we manage.

facts.label: When it does not
facts.text: When you take the code and host and manage it yourself.

facts.label: Changes and updates
facts.text: Not included. Use hours from a Keystroke Savers plan, or ask for a quote.

hosting.unit: a month, for your website and tool together

websites.title: Website builds
websites.what: Two fixed-price builds. The difference is who runs the site afterwards: us, or you.

facts.label: How it is built
facts.text: A new site, built in code by Keystroke.

facts.label: Hosting
facts.text: We host and manage it, or you deploy the code yourself.

facts.label: Ongoing costs
facts.text: $89 a month for hosting and maintenance if we manage it. Nothing if you host it yourself.

facts.label: Who makes changes
facts.text: We do, with hours from a Keystroke Savers plan or as quoted work.

facts.label: Best for
facts.text: A business that wants its site run for it.

facts.label: How it is built
facts.text: In WordPress, with the Elementor page builder.

facts.label: Hosting
facts.text: On hosting you own. We can set it up.

facts.label: Ongoing costs
facts.text: You pay for hosting, the domain and any plugin and theme subscriptions directly.

facts.label: Who makes changes
facts.text: You do, after one hour of training. We do on request.

facts.label: Best for
facts.text: A business that wants to edit its own pages.

after: When a site built in code is delivered, you choose one of two paths. We host and manage it, for $89 a month. Or you take the code and host it yourself, and our part ends at handover.
On the WordPress build, every account and licence is held in your name. We set them up on request, and never pay for them on your behalf.

audits.title: Audits
audits.what: Two ways to start. One is free and quick. The other counts a whole process, at a fixed price we quote once we know the process.

items.name: Initial audit
items.includes: A quick overview only. It is not an in-depth audit.

items.name: The Keystroke Audit
items.unit: as a fixed price, once scoped
items.includes: One process counted end to end, a shift report, a scoped quote for the build, and one initial tool.
